records.title: A Cloud-Driven Support Layer for Enhancing Distributed IDS in IoT Networks
records.reason: The official Springer abstract concerns cloud-guided multi-agent intrusion detection for IoT edge nodes. Its reported gains are detection accuracy and collaboration efficiency for that application; no LLM execution, serving, or transferable inference-system contribution is shown.

records.title: Learning More from Less: Unlocking Internal Representations for Benchmark Compression
records.reason: RepCore reduces the number of LLM benchmark items needed for performance extrapolation using aligned hidden-state representations; this improves evaluation cost, not deployed inference/serving cost, so retain only as a possible benchmark-efficiency connection.

records.title: AI Developments for T and B Cell Receptor Modeling and Therapeutic Design
records.reason: The paper surveys AI methods for T/B-cell receptor modeling and therapeutic design; its subject is biomedical application rather than inference/serving efficiency.

records.title: Submodular Evaluation Subset Selection in Automatic Prompt Optimization
records.reason: The method selects submodular evaluation subsets for automatic prompt optimization; any efficiency gain is in the optimizer/evaluation loop, while LLM inference or serving cost is not established.

records.title: MODE: Efficient Time Series Prediction with Mamba Enhanced by Low-Rank Neural ODEs
records.reason: MODE improves computational efficiency and scalability for long-range time-series prediction, but its target is time-series modeling in application domains and it does not establish LLM inference or serving efficiency.

records.title: MambaStereo: enhancing stereo matching accuracy in ill-posed regions via Mamba-based cost volume
records.reason: The official Springer abstract describes MambaStereo for stereo-depth matching and says partial 3D convolutions reduce computation while maintaining vision accuracy. This is a concrete but task-specific stereo-vision optimization; a transferable inference-system contribution beyond the linked Mamba lineage is not established, so retain as borderline.

records.title: Chorus: Harmonizing Context and Sensing Signals for Data-Free Model Customization in IoT
records.reason: Chorus adds an adaptive cache and lightweight prediction head for on-device model inference and reports latency comparable to sensor-only deployment, but its workloads are sensing/speech models rather than LLMs; retain for edge-inference relevance review.

records.title: PrivLLMSwarm: Privacy-Preserving LLM-Driven UAV Swarms for Secure IoT Surveillance
records.reason: PrivLLMSwarm performs encrypted LLM inference on resource-constrained UAV platforms and reports low encrypted inference latency; MPC-optimized Transformer components and approximate activations are a concrete edge-inference efficiency contribution, though privacy is also a core goal.
